limitations: Independent Korean-language review remains pending. Source-backed policy judgments are not a precision benchmark.

443 native single-ㅂ predicate entries: 56 regular, 377 irregular, 10 unknown. Written 니 forms classify regular/irregular; written 운/온 confirms two adnominal-only irregular entries. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed for comparison, while original written strings remain in evidence.

Ten entries lack usable forms: 향그럽다, 메시껍다, 뵙다, 싸잡다, 안스럽다, 졸립다, 종잡다, 줄잡다, 차겁다, 찾아뵙다. Some are nonstandard cross-reference entries. Unknown retention is not a positive spelling judgment; shortened-stem restrictions and spelling repair remain separate work.
꽃답다 and 참답다 retain their source usage notes and adnominal-only examples. Their written 운 form establishes an irregular class; this does not certify every ending or contextual usage.

곱디곱 uses 오 before 아/어 and 우 before (으) endings. 듣잡/받잡 use 오 in both positions. The raw generator changes these three finite heads only; broader arbitrary compounds and historical paradigms are not inferred.
Native 곱다/굽다 homonyms retain separate regular/irregular evidence. At least one supported entry keeps a reading; sentence sense selection is not performed.
-답다 already enforces its fixed irregular class in the raw derivation. Its constraint is not assigned to the preceding nominal lemma, while following auxiliary requirements remain independently owned.

Of 1674 dictionary-written forms, 1673 recover their headword after compatible filtering. Source krdict:67256 lists 얃잡는 under 얕잡다; the original string and missing recovery are explicitly regression-tracked. No source correction or spelling-repair rule is introduced.

EntryMatch adds optional bieup evidence, and SpellingClass adds BieupRegular/BieupIrregular. Old JSON remains readable with unknown missing evidence; Rust struct literals/exhaustive matches need the additions. Database schema is unchanged.

Across 8000 compared inputs, 39 raw candidates are added and 24 removed on 43 surfaces, all through the three finite heads. Shared candidate order/rule IDs and prior ㅎ/ㄷ/ㅅ requirements remain unchanged. One stress snapshot adds only ㅂ metadata and retains the prior hash.

Eight complete training sentences preserve their target gold groups after filtering. All frozen corpus reports and gold baselines are unchanged. On the novel, headword-only candidates remain unchanged; the two compatible-filter removals are 지워→집다 and 어원→업다, both traced to written-class conflicts.
르/러 and other lexical paradigms, separate shortened-stem conditions and remaining 하다 spelling classes remain open under COV-021.
